_meta.purpose: Parameter-by-parameter old-regime vs new-regime matrix. This is the data behind your two-column comparison screen.
_meta.key_insight: NOTHING was abolished in the 1961 to 2025 transition. Every deduction was carried over and renumbered. The old-vs-new REGIME split is unchanged; it is the SECTION NUMBERS that moved.

field_key.old_regime: true = claimable under the old regime
field_key.new_regime: true = claimable under the new regime (s.115BAC / s.202)

new_regime_survivor_list._note: Build the new-regime branch of your calculator from EXACTLY this list. Everything else is old-regime only.
items: 80CCD(2) / s.124 - employer NPS contribution at 14% of Basic+DA for ALL employers
24(b) - interest on LET-OUT property, uncapped (but the resulting loss is stranded - see house_property_loss_trap)
24(a) - 30% standard deduction on Net Annual Value
Gratuity, leave encashment, commuted pension, VRS, retrenchment compensation (s.19)
Duty allowances - tour, transfer, daily, conveyance, helper, academic, uniform (actuals only)
Employer EPF contribution (within the Rs 7.5L combined cap)
PPF / SSY / NPS / 10(10D) life insurance maturity exemptions
Post office savings interest - Rs 3,500 individual / Rs 7,000 joint

deductions.name: Standard deduction (salary/pension)
deductions.conditions: Salaried and pensioners only. No bills required. Lower of the cap and salary.

deductions.name: Family pension deduction
deductions.conditions: Lower of one-third of family pension and the cap. Taxed under Income from Other Sources.

deductions.name: Professional / employment tax
deductions.conditions: Levied under Article 276(2). Actual amount paid.

deductions.name: Entertainment allowance
deductions.limit_old: least of Rs 5,000 / 20% of salary / actual
deductions.conditions: GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEES ONLY.

deductions.name: Investments and specified payments
deductions.conditions: Individuals and HUFs only. Aggregate cap across 80C + 80CCC + 80CCD(1). Unchanged since FY 2014-15.
qualifying_items: 5-year tax-saver fixed deposits with scheduled banks
Stamp duty and registration charges (year of purchase only)
Tuition fees - max 2 children, full-time, in India

deductions.name: NPS - own contribution
deductions.limit_old: Salaried: 10% of Basic+DA. Self-employed: 20% of GTI. Inside the Rs 1.5L cap.
deductions.conditions: Tier I only.

deductions.name: NPS - additional deduction
deductions.conditions: Over and above the Rs 1.5L cap. Tier I only. Total personal NPS benefit Rs 2L in the old regime.

deductions.name: NPS - EMPLOYER contribution
deductions.limit_old: Government employer: 14% of Basic+DA. Private employer: 10% of Basic+DA.
deductions.conditions: Salaried only; the self-employed cannot claim. No rupee ceiling, only a percentage cap. Must ALSO pass the Rs 7.5L combined employer-contribution cap - two independent gates.
deductions.flag: HIGHEST-IMPACT NEW-REGIME LEVER. A private-sector employee gains 4 extra percentage points of Basic+DA in the new regime. On Rs 20L of Basic+DA that is Rs 80,000 of deduction available ONLY in the new regime. A comparison engine that ignores this systematically understates the new regime.

deductions.name: Agniveer Corpus Fund
deductions.limit_old: own contribution PLUS the Government's matching contribution, in full
deductions.conditions: Agnipath Scheme enrollees, from FY 2022-23.

sub_rules.preventive_health_checkup: Rs 5,000 - WITHIN, not on top of, the above limits
sub_rules.seniors_without_insurance: May claim actual medical expenditure up to the Rs 50,000 ceiling instead of premium

deductions.name: Maintenance of a disabled dependant
deductions.conditions: FLAT deduction, not expense-linked. Dependant = spouse, children, parents, siblings. Cannot also claim 80U for the same person.

deductions.name: Medical treatment - specified diseases
deductions.conditions: Actual expenditure, reduced by insurance or employer reimbursement. Specialist prescription required.
specified_diseases: neurological conditions (dementia, dystonia musculorum deformans, Parkinson's, motor neuron disease, chorea, ataxia, aphasia, hemiballismus)

deductions.name: Self with disability
deductions.conditions: Certificate from a Government hospital medical authority; Form 10-IA. Permanent disability needs no annual renewal.

deductions.name: Education loan interest
deductions.conditions: Max 8 consecutive years from the year repayment starts, or until interest is fully repaid. Loan from a bank, approved FI or charitable institution. For self, spouse, children or ward. PRINCIPAL is not deductible.

deductions.name: Home loan interest - first-time buyer
deductions.conditions: Loan sanctioned in FY 2016-17; property value <= Rs 50L; loan <= Rs 35L; no other house owned.

deductions.name: Home loan interest - affordable housing
deductions.conditions: Loan sanctioned 1 Apr 2019 - 31 Mar 2022; stamp duty value <= Rs 45L; no other house owned.

deductions.name: Electric vehicle loan interest
deductions.conditions: Loan sanctioned 1 Apr 2019 - 31 Mar 2023 from a bank or NBFC.

deductions.name: Donations

categories.examples: National Defence Fund, PM CARES Fund, PM National Relief Fund, National Children's Fund, approved universities of national eminence, National Blood Transfusion Council
PM Drought Relief Fund; certain memorial funds (several discontinued from FY 2023-24)
Family planning promotion; sports infrastructure via approved bodies
Approved charitable institutions; local authority for charitable purposes (excl. family planning); renovation of notified temples/mosques/churches of historic importance

deductions.qualifying_limit_rule: 10% of adjusted gross total income (adjusted GTI excludes certain capital gains, exempt income and Chapter VI-A deductions)
deductions.documentation: Donee must report the donation; Form 10BE certificate; donee's 80G registration number

deductions.name: Rent paid where no HRA is received
deductions.limit_old: LEAST of: (a) Rs 5,000/month = Rs 60,000/yr; (b) 25% of adjusted total income; (c) rent paid minus 10% of adjusted total income
deductions.conditions: Must NOT receive HRA. Must not own residential property at the work or residence location (nor spouse / minor child / HUF). Form 10BA declaration required.

deductions.name: Political contributions - individual
deductions.conditions: CASH STRICTLY DISALLOWED. To a registered political party or electoral trust. High scrutiny / notice risk.

deductions.name: Scientific research donations
deductions.conditions: Cash above Rs 2,000 disallowed. Not for those with business income.

deductions.name: Savings account interest (under 60)
deductions.conditions: SAVINGS BANK ACCOUNTS ONLY (bank / co-op / post office). FDs and RDs excluded. Individuals and HUF under 60.

deductions.name: Deposit interest - senior citizens
deductions.conditions: Savings PLUS fixed PLUS recurring deposits. Senior citizens 60+. Mutually exclusive with 80TTA.
deductions.rejected_claim: One source claims the limit rose to Rs 1,00,000 for FY 2026-27. This is UNVERIFIED and traces to pre-Budget advocacy commentary, not enacted law. A dedicated AY 2026-27 source states it has NOT been raised. USE Rs 50,000.

deductions.name: Additional employee cost
deductions.limit_old: 30% of additional employee cost, for 3 consecutive tax years
deductions.conditions: Business audited u/s 44AB; 10+ new employees; business operational 240+ days; employee salary <= Rs 25,000/month; employed 240+ days (150 days for leather/apparel/footwear); member of a recognised PF; not wholly EPF-funded by Government; Form 10DA with CA certification and DSC; not formed by splitting or reconstruction. Claimable even on a belated return.

deductions.name: House Rent Allowance exemption
deductions.formula: Exemption = LEAST of: (1) actual HRA received; (2) 50% of salary (metro) or 40% (non-metro); (3) rent paid minus 10% of salary
deductions.salary_definition: Basic + DA forming part of retirement benefits + commission based on a fixed percentage of turnover
deductions.metro_expansion_warning: HIGHEST-IMPACT UNVERIFIED ITEM IN THIS FILE. Five-plus sources agree the metro list expands from 4 to 8 cities from FY 2026-27, lifting Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Ahmedabad from 40% to 50%. But NO source cited the gazette notification number or the rule number in the Income-tax Rules, 2026. Ship this behind a feature flag and confirm against the bare Rules.
deductions.landlord_pan: Mandatory if annual rent exceeds Rs 1,00,000. If the landlord has no PAN, a self-declaration is required (Circular 8/2013).
deductions.rent_to_family: Permitted but needs a genuine payment trail; heavily scrutinised.
deductions.hra_plus_home_loan: Can be claimed together if genuinely renting (e.g. own house let out, or in another city).

deductions.name: Leave Travel Allowance / Concession
deductions.limit_old: Lower of LTA received and actual travel fare. Capped at economy air fare or AC first-class rail by the shortest route.
deductions.frequency: 2 journeys in a block of 4 calendar years
deductions.carry_over: One unused journey may be carried to the FIRST year of the next block
deductions.covered: TRAVEL FARE ONLY - self, spouse, children (max 2 born after 1.10.1998), dependent parents and siblings
deductions.geography: DOMESTIC travel only. International journeys are fully taxable.
deductions.fy2026_27_change: Form 12BB replaced by Form 124. ACTUAL TRAVEL PROOF (tickets, boarding passes, payment confirmation) becomes mandatory.
deductions.draft_only: A road-travel cap of ~Rs 30/km appears in DRAFT rules only. NOT confirmed as notified. Do not implement.

deductions.name: Home loan interest - self-occupied
deductions.conditions: Construction must be complete. Rs 30,000 for pre-1999 loans (legacy).

deductions.name: Home loan interest - LET OUT property
deductions.flag: Survives in the new regime - but see house_property_loss_trap. The deduction is only useful up to rental income.

deductions.name: Pre-construction interest
deductions.limit_old: 5 equal annual instalments from the year of completion; for self-occupied it sits INSIDE the Rs 2L cap
deductions.note: For a LET-OUT property this should follow let-out treatment, but that was not separately confirmed for the new regime.

house_property_loss_trap._flag: THE MOST COMMON MODELLING ERROR IN REGIME-COMPARISON TOOLS. Get this wrong and you will materially over-credit the new regime.

old_regime.setoff_against_other_heads: ALLOWED, capped at Rs 2,00,000 per year
old_regime.carry_forward: 8 years, against future house property income

new_regime.setoff_against_other_heads: NOT ALLOWED AT ALL - not merely capped, zero
new_regime.carry_forward: NOT PERMITTED - the loss is extinguished

house_property_loss_trap.consequence: A new-regime user with a let-out property gets full interest deduction, but only up to rental income. Any excess creates a loss that cannot touch salary and cannot be carried forward. It simply evaporates. A naive calculator that subtracts interest from total income will over-credit the new regime.

allowances_surviving_in_new_regime._basis: s.10(14)(i) / Rule 2BB, now Schedule III. Exempt ONLY to the extent actually spent; the unspent balance is taxable salary.

items.name: Daily allowance on tour
items.exemption: actual ordinary daily charges during absence from normal duty

items.name: Conveyance allowance for official duties
items.exemption: actual - only where free conveyance is not provided. Desk-bound roles: fully taxable

non_salary_exempt_both_regimes.name: Employer EPF contribution
non_salary_exempt_both_regimes.treatment: exempt up to the Rs 7.5L combined cap

non_salary_exempt_both_regimes.name: NPS maturity and Tier-I partial withdrawal
Life insurance maturity 10(10D)
non_salary_exempt_both_regimes.treatment: exempt, subject to the >Rs 5L annual premium rule for policies issued after 1 Apr 2023 (then slab-taxed)

disputed_new_regime_availability.status: Sources conflict on both availability and amounts. Treat as UNVERIFIED.

retirement_benefits_s19._note: The 2025 Act collapses the scattered 10(10)-series exemptions into s.19 as deductions from salary. Structurally different, economically the same. ALL survive in the NEW regime.

items.name: Gratuity - covered by Payment of Gratuity Act
items.limit: least of Rs 20,00,000 / 15 days' salary x years / actual

items.name: Gratuity - not covered
items.limit: least of 3 limits; lifetime ceiling Rs 20,00,000

items.name: Leave encashment - non-Government
items.limit: least of 4 limits; lifetime ceiling Rs 25,00,000 (raised from Rs 3L w.e.f. FY 2023-24)

items.name: Commuted pension - non-Government
items.limit: 1/3 of commuted value if gratuity also received; 1/2 if not

items.name: Retrenchment compensation
items.limit: least of statutory ID Act amount / actual / Rs 5,00,000

perquisite_valuation._note: Perquisites are income INCLUSIONS, not deductions. They apply in BOTH regimes. Some of these changes are taxpayer-NEGATIVE and must be modelled or you will understate tax.

specified_employee_salary_threshold.effect: Employees with monetary salary <= Rs 4L escape perquisite taxation on car, domestic servant, gas/electricity, education etc. entirely

changes.warning: Source does not state whether this is per MONTH or per YEAR. Do not implement until resolved.

employer_contribution_cap.rule: Rs 7,50,000 per year COMBINED across employer contributions to recognised PF + approved superannuation fund + NPS. Excess is a taxable perquisite.
employer_contribution_cap.accretion: s.17(2)(viia) - annual accretion (interest/dividend/other return) ON THE TAXABLE EXCESS is also a perquisite, computed under Rule 3B.
employer_contribution_cap.rule_3B_formula: TP = (PC/2) x R + (PC1 + TP1) x R, where R = accrued income / average fund balance
employer_contribution_cap.in_force_since: Finance Act 2020; accretion taxable from AY 2021-22
employer_contribution_cap.interaction_with_80CCD2: Two SEPARATE gates. A contribution must pass both: (a) within 14%/10% of Basic+DA for the deduction, and (b) within the Rs 7.5L combined ceiling to avoid perquisite treatment. High earners with generous employer NPS plus superannuation can breach Rs 7.5L while still inside the 14% limit. Model both independently.

general_both_regimes.restriction: Once carried forward, cannot be set off against salary
Against HP income; inter-head capped at Rs 2L (old regime only)

set_off_and_carry_forward.due_date_rule: Return must be filed by the s.139(1) / s.263 due date to preserve carry-forward of business, speculative and capital losses. EXCEPTIONS: house-property loss and unabsorbed depreciation survive a belated return.
new_regime_specific_disallowances: House property loss - inter-head set-off COMPLETELY disallowed
House property loss - carry forward NOT permitted
Any loss arising from disallowed deductions (32(1)(iia) additional depreciation, 32AD, 33AB, 35AD, 10AA SEZ) cannot be set off in the current year and cannot be carried forward
Brought-forward depreciation attributable to additional depreciation is not allowed; it is adjusted into the WDV of the block as at 1 April of the first new-regime year
Capital losses are generally UNAFFECTED - normal set-off and 8-year carry-forward preserved
set_off_and_carry_forward.app_implication: For any user with carried-forward losses, especially business or house property, the old regime can be worth far more than a headline slab comparison suggests. Surface an explicit warning rather than a silent number.
